rootCause: Manual recovery manifests for J2/J4/J5/J6 reused primaryBaseHead ef6a4d2c66aabcc5eef128924da3442c3347e043 while the manifests were committed sequentially after that head. VAEP transport correctly rejected each affected manifest because primaryBaseHead must equal the immediate dispatch parent. The failure occurred before Jules execution/session creation, so these are transport-control failures, not no-value Jules waves.

evidence.observedInvariant: PRIMARY_BASE_HEAD ef6a4d2c66aabcc5eef128924da3442c3347e043 is not dispatch parent 02d04733eec703183a9533fa2a58764be02ac151

correctiveAction: Create exactly one R2 manifest per affected lane sequentially. Each R2 primaryBaseHead MUST equal the live Desarrollo HEAD immediately before that manifest commit, so the resulting dispatch commit has the declared base as its immediate parent. Preserve the same exclusive material scope. If any R2 becomes terminal without useful value, do not create R3 or another Jules session; CHATGPT_VAEP takes over the exact scope directly.
